title: Interference and radio-quality contract post-change canonical audit

contract.co_channel_eligibility_rule: exact channel_id, frequency_ghz, bandwidth_mhz, and technology match
contract.optimization_coupling: diagnostic-only; no radio-quality KPI feeds canonical optimization
contract.serving_admission_rule: serving selection requires strict received_carrier_power_dbm > the effective per-cell receiver sensitivity; finite non-serving signals are still eligible for co-channel interference

compatibility_assessment.canonical_optimizer: exact stored baseline/optimized metrics and Pareto recommendation retained
compatibility_assessment.propagation_and_raw_surfaces: unchanged code path; no radio-quality value feeds canonical propagation scoring
compatibility_assessment.receiver_sensitivity: remains a strict raw-carrier admission gate and is not added to the SINR denominator
compatibility_assessment.pre_change_reference: docs/concept-4h1-pre-change-baseline.json and the preceding Concept 4G.2 worktree baseline; aggregate counts are not treated as a direct 4H-only diff because the pre-change worktree already contained Concept 4G.2 changes
